title: Copilot Notebooks: JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources
summary: The rollout facts, licensing attribution and documented controls are supported. The statement that the Cloud Policy setting cannot allow documents while excluding images goes beyond Microsoft's documentation; describe the missing documented file-type selector instead of asserting that restriction is impossible.

claims.fix: Replace 'It does not distinguish file types, so it cannot allow documents while excluding images.' with 'At the time of writing (November 2026), the admin and TCM resource pages document no file-type selector for this setting.'
